children: Binance Wallet announced on X that it has updated several product features across its wallet, web, and API tools. LP Zap now supports more EVM chains, while the LP pop-up has been upgraded to include range view and liquidity removal functions. The Markets page has also been refreshed with Overview, Meme, and Stocks sections. In addition, the Tokenized Securities detail page now supports perpetuals trading and Square, and the Extension now supports Dust Conversion.

The announcement also said the Web3 API has been updated with BSC DeFi, B402 payments, and permissions. On the web version, token notification pop-ups now display market cap information, and search now supports one-click purchases through Flash Buy. Token detail pages also now support customizable metrics. Binance Wallet did not provide additional details beyond the list of feature changes in the update.

title: Binance Wallet Expands LP Zap, Markets Page, and Web3 API Features
